newsitem.title: USA: US Commerce chief Daley sees lower 1997 trade gap.
newsitem.headline: US Commerce chief Daley sees lower 1997 trade gap.

text.p: Commerce Secretary William Daley said on Wednesday that he expects the U.S. trade deficit to narrow this year.
"Our trade deficit numbers in '97 will be good," he told a news conference.
The Commerce Department reported earler that the U.S. trade deficit rose 8.7 percent last year to $114.23 billion, the highest since 1988's $115.5 billion.
"I think 1997 will be a good year for the economy," Daley said, adding, "Our competitiveness is unquestioned in the world."
He said the United States will continue to take "an aggressive stand" on opening up both Japan and China's markets to more imports.
